title: Why do some people grow faster? 🧬
caption:
In a study of hundreds of people doing the same 12-week arm program, some barely grew while others grew their biceps by more than half. Genes matter, but low responders usually still improve with more volume, time or a different plan. Compare you to the old you 👇

Muscle Building, Part 19
first_comment: That one friend who grows by looking at a dumbbell 😤 Tag them
